column1: # the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block; the heap check (needs the Mac host) never ran, so the split is set by hand

# the game asks for a 0x81200000 (2.02 GB) heap (pool 0xCD500000 - its ~1.12 GB virtual address memory - 64 MB used); the guessed 0x118000000 alias left only a 0x8000000 (128 MB) heap region, so SetHeapSize returned 0xD401 and the game aborted at nninitStartup

# the alias region keeps the virtual address memory room (62 MB node area + the game's own regions) and the heap region takes the rest of the block: 0x140000000 - 0x10000000 - 0x80000000 - 0x10000000 = 0xA0000000 (2.50 GB)

# the game's own VirtualMemoryAllocator::Initialize reserves 0x2d1400000 (11.27 GiB) of virtual address space in one nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion: the SDK's VammManager places the regions in the alias region, so the alias window has to hold it (on the Switch the alias region is 64 GB) plus the SDK's node area (62 MB after the cut) and its own StandardAllocator region (pool - used = 3.15 GiB): a 16 GB alias, the heap region still 2.50 GB, the guest block 19 GB (0x10000000 front + 0x400000000 alias + 0x10000000 stack + 0xA0000000 heap)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# the engine fills its textures on the CPU into a pool and publishes them with a pool flush: without the upload they stay zeros on the GPU and the 3D scene is black (the 2D HUD has its own textures)
